'''The Swirling Vortex''' was the most popular [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Cantina|bar]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vydat Stardock]].<ref name="University">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref>

It was owned by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Elav Feen]]. The bartender was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] named [[Orrsa]].<ref name="University" />
